snippet.title: Night Owls Full Gameplay
snippet.description:
Vine Moss Games is a new studio committed to delivering interactive experiences on human complexities. Follow for updates on Night Owls and future VM games at vine-moss-games.itch.io.

--
In 2004, Serenity Scott was a sophomore at Mercer University, studying anthropology and computational science. Investigators say she engaged in frequent online conversations with an unidentified individual that went by the psuedonym "hoot83", whose identity has never been verified. 

Serenity Scott was last seen on October 22nd, 2004. To this day, her whereabouts are unknown. No evidence suggests there was foul play.

Night Owls is a ~20 min unsettling narrative that marks the 20-year anniversary of the disappearance of a 20-year-old woman.
